notes.title: Release Date Set: Nov 1st
notes.notes:
We're very excited to announce that Guns and Grapples will be transitioning from early access to full release on November 1st, 2021.

To celebrate the occasion we will also be releasing a demo version of the game that allows players to experience a small portion of the game for free.

The team at Bit Shifters would like to express how grateful we are to our fans and early access players for your feedback and support. We've worked hard to implement your suggestions and create the best possible experience for our players.

Thank you everyone. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Daily Challenge Update
notes.notes:
Challenge Mode
- Rename "RNG" to "Daily Challenge" and "Custom Challenge"
- Save custom random seed times (local only)
- More variety to random levels
- Add skin selector to menu
- Generate seed button
- Display leaderboard from menu
- Display challenge time remaining
- Minor bug fixes

Main Menu
- Minor visual updates
- Community menu in options with links to discord, social media and email
- Feedback menu in options
- Escape key clicks back button

Gameplay
- Skeleton king roar bug fixed to use volume settings in options
- Levels 1-9 and 1-11 slightly easier
- Reduce velocity loss when hitting water
- Drown faster

Sounds/Music
- New character voices by Dadbeard, MykroMayem and Bill White
- New chiptune music tracks by Brian O'Mahoney

notes.title: Daily RNG Level Challenge Patch
notes.notes: You can now compete in a daily randomly generated level against others in the leaderboards. See the RNG Level in the world select menu. A new level/leaderboard is generated at midnight GMT time.
